# BrewCraft Coffee Roasters (Chennai, India)
> Artisanal micro-roastery, specialty brew bar, and single-origin coffee distributor situated in Alwarpet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Organization & Brand Identity
- **Business Name**: BrewCraft Coffee Roasters
- **Category**: Specialty Coffee Roastery, Cafe, and Direct-Trade Indian Coffee Merchant
- **Founding Location**: Alwarpet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, 600018, India
- **Core Philosophy**: Sourcing single-origin Arabica and washed specialty coffees exclusively from sustainable shade-grown estates in the Western Ghats (Chikmagalur, Shevaroy Hills, and Araku Valley), precision batch-roasting on vintage drum roasters, and elevating South Indian filter coffee with artisanal craftsmanship.

## Physical Roastery & Cafe
- **Address**: 42/1 Eldams Road, Alwarpet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600018, India
- **Operating Hours**: Monday through Sunday: 07:00 AM – 10:00 PM IST
- **Phone**: +91 44 2499 1890
- **Email**: hello@brewcraftcoffee.in
- **Geo Coordinates**: Latitude 13.0336, Longitude 80.2520

## Flagship Offerings
- **Kaveri Reserve (Signature Filter Coffee Blend)**: 80% washed Arabica from Shevaroys + 20% high-grown chicory, designed for traditional brass dabarah and tumbler brewing. Notes: dark jaggery, roasted hazelnut, malt.
- **Shevaroys Single-Origin Arabica (Microlot 46)**: Light-medium roast, altitude 1450m. Tasting notes: orange blossom, stone fruit, cane sugar sweetness.
- **Baba Budangiri Estate Red Honey**: Medium roast Arabica from Chikmagalur heritage terroir. Tasting notes: milk chocolate, dried fig, lingering floral finish.
- **Monsooned Malabar AA**: Heavy body, low acidity espresso roast. Tasting notes: earthy cedar, dark cocoa, spice.
- **Brew Bar Services**: V60 Pour-over, Aeropress, Cold Drip Cascara, Manual Lever Espresso, and Traditional Brass Dabarah Filter Service with A2 dairy or oat milk options.
